attributes.board_name: South Carolina Board of Pharmacy (SC LLR)

rules.accepted_credit_types: ACPE (American Council on Pharmaceutical Education) or CME Category I approved continuing education
rules.new_licensee_rule: Exempt while enrolled in a pharmacy technician program and during the first renewal period after completing it, or after initial registration.
rules.carryover: Excess hours may be carried forward to the next registration year only.
rules.audit_note: Board audits CE of a random 10% of renewing technicians.
rules.notes: Registration runs July 1 to June 30 and is renewed annually; no renewal without CE certification on the application. Certified pharmacy technicians must also keep PTCB/Board-approved exam certification current.
rules.rule_quote: (G)(1) As a condition of registration renewal, a registered pharmacy technician shall complete ten hours of American Council on Pharmaceutical Education or CME I approved continuing education each year, beginning with the next renewal period after June 30, 2003.
